locations.description: A quiet, soft bedroom prepared for bedtime, with the child's bed, a small crib for the new baby, and enough floor space for a friendly small dragon to curl up. The room feels safe, warm, and calm, with rounded furniture and uncluttered surfaces.
locations.lighting: dim warm bedside glow mixed with cool blue moonlight; soft shadows, no harsh contrast
locations.name: Shared child-and-baby bedroom
locations.topology: Single indoor room. The doorway opens into the main bedroom area; the child bed sits opposite or slightly angled toward the crib; the crib is along the wall; open floor space connects doorway, bed, and crib. Keep all zones visually compatible as parts of the same room.

recurringProps.description: Low, safe wooden bed with rounded corners, pillow, and enough room for the child to be tucked in without seeming trapped.
recurringProps.material: light wood frame, soft cotton bedding
recurringProps.name: child's bed
recurringProps.persistence: Present throughout the bedroom scenes; geometry and position remain consistent.
recurringProps.scale: child-sized bed, larger than crib and smaller than adult bed

recurringProps.description: Soft blanket that begins gently tucked, becomes over-folded by Dini, then is adjusted to leave a small movement gap.
recurringProps.material: quilted cotton or fleece with subtle stitched texture
recurringProps.name: main child blanket
recurringProps.persistence: Key recurring object on every page; folds and gap must track page-by-page state.
recurringProps.scale: large enough to cover child from shoulders to feet

recurringProps.description: Small crib by the wall for the new baby, with rounded slats and a calm, minimal look.
recurringProps.name: small crib
recurringProps.persistence: Visible or implied throughout; remains near the wall in the same position.
recurringProps.scale: baby-sized, clearly smaller than the child's bed

recurringProps.description: Small blanket inside the crib, visually distinct from the child's larger blanket.
recurringProps.name: baby blanket
recurringProps.persistence: Stays in the crib; should not migrate to the child bed.

recurringProps.description: Small soft teddy bear within reach of the child through the blanket gap.
recurringProps.name: teddy bear
recurringProps.persistence: Introduced clearly when touched; may be visible near the bed before and after.

recurringProps.description: Soft rug beside the bed where Dini can stand, fold with her tail, and later lie down.
recurringProps.name: bedside rug
recurringProps.persistence: Maintains floor continuity between bed, doorway, and crib.
recurringProps.scale: large enough for a small dragon to curl beside the bed
